loudness_rule: peak ceiling -3.0 dBFS; loudest 50 ms RMS aimed at -14.5 dBFS plus each sound's trim_db

sounds.name: jump
sounds.trigger: Player leaves the ground with a normal or buffered jump

sounds.name: wall_kick
sounds.trigger: Player kicks off a wall

sounds.name: land_soft
sounds.trigger: Player lands from a short fall

sounds.name: land_hard
sounds.trigger: Player lands from a long fall or a dash-fall

sounds.name: dash
sounds.trigger: Player starts a dash

sounds.name: stomp_1
sounds.trigger: Player lands on an enemy, first in a chain

sounds.name: stomp_2
sounds.trigger: Second enemy in the same air chain

sounds.name: stomp_3
sounds.trigger: Third or later enemy in the same air chain

sounds.name: bump_block
sounds.trigger: Player's head hits a block that still has something in it

sounds.name: bump_used
sounds.trigger: Player's head hits an empty or solid block

sounds.name: brick_break
sounds.trigger: Charged player breaks a brick with a head bump

sounds.name: shard
sounds.trigger: Player collects a shard

sounds.name: big_shard
sounds.trigger: Player collects one of the three big shards

sounds.name: extra_life
sounds.trigger: Player earns a life (100 shards or a 1UP block)

sounds.name: charge_get
sounds.trigger: Player picks up CHARGE

sounds.name: charge_lose
sounds.trigger: Charged player is hit and loses CHARGE (survives)

sounds.name: death
sounds.trigger: Player dies (hit uncharged, pit, crush or timer)

sounds.name: spring
sounds.trigger: Player is thrown upward by a spring

sounds.name: lift_ring
sounds.trigger: Player passes through a lift ring (dash refilled, popped up)

sounds.name: checkpoint
sounds.trigger: Player lights the midway beacon

sounds.name: mast_touch
sounds.trigger: Player grabs the goal mast (plays before the slide)

sounds.name: mast_slide
sounds.trigger: Player slides down the mast to the ground

sounds.name: level_clear
sounds.trigger: Level finished (after the mast slide)

sounds.name: world_clear
sounds.trigger: World finished: the Gate is lit

sounds.name: game_over
sounds.trigger: Last life lost (restart the world at level 1)

sounds.name: timer_warning
sounds.trigger: Level timer drops below 100

sounds.name: pause
sounds.trigger: Game paused or unpaused

sounds.name: menu_move
sounds.trigger: Menu cursor moves

sounds.name: menu_confirm
sounds.trigger: Menu choice confirmed

sounds.name: loose_floor_shake
sounds.trigger: Loose floor starts its 0.35 s shake after being stood on

sounds.name: loose_floor_crack
sounds.trigger: Loose floor breaks free (end of the shake)

sounds.name: loose_floor_fall
sounds.trigger: Loose floor drops (plays while falling)

sounds.name: loose_floor_land
sounds.trigger: Fallen floor lands as rubble (also crushes what is below)

sounds.name: loose_ceiling_crack
sounds.trigger: Loose ceiling chunk breaks loose (0.4 s before it falls)

sounds.name: loose_ceiling_fall
sounds.trigger: Ceiling chunk falls (plays while dropping)

sounds.name: loose_ceiling_land
sounds.trigger: Ceiling chunk hits the ground

sounds.name: press_shake
sounds.trigger: Press shakes for 0.3 s as its warning before a slam

sounds.name: press_slam
sounds.trigger: Press hits the floor

sounds.name: spike_warn
sounds.trigger: Spike vent about to fire (short tell before the spikes rise)

sounds.name: spike_pop
sounds.trigger: Spikes spring up from a vent

sounds.name: dropper_tell
sounds.trigger: Dropper lets go (player passed underneath)

sounds.name: dropper_slam
sounds.trigger: Dropper hits the ground

sounds.name: dropper_rise
sounds.trigger: Dropper winds back up to the ceiling (retrigger if longer)

sounds.name: plate_click
sounds.trigger: Pressure plate pressed down

sounds.name: gate_open
sounds.trigger: Gate slides open

sounds.name: gate_close
sounds.trigger: Gate slides shut (timed gates closing too)

sounds.name: lever_pull
sounds.trigger: Player pulls the lever

sounds.name: bridge_collapse
sounds.trigger: Lever drops the bridge: planks give way one after another

sounds.name: warden_step
sounds.trigger: Warden footstep while pacing the bridge

sounds.name: warden_hop
sounds.trigger: Warden jumps

sounds.name: warden_fall
sounds.trigger: Warden falls when the bridge collapses (scream as it drops)

sounds.name: walker_squish
sounds.trigger: Walker flattened by a stomp (play with stomp_N)

sounds.name: hopper_hop
sounds.trigger: Hopper jumps

sounds.name: hopper_land
sounds.trigger: Hopper lands (pairs with hopper_hop)

sounds.name: channel_switch
sounds.trigger: Player bumps a channel switch block: the solid and outline blocks swap

sounds.name: channel_arm
sounds.trigger: Relay boss is about to swap the channels by itself: play when its 0.3 s warning starts, it ends as the swap lands (then channel_swap)

sounds.name: channel_swap
sounds.trigger: The relay boss swaps the channels: blocks change over (plays as channel_arm ends)

sounds.name: spiky_knock
sounds.trigger: Spiked walker knocked out from below or crushed by a trap

sounds.name: spiky_hurt
sounds.trigger: Player touches a spiked walker's spikes (the sting only: death or charge_lose plays as well)

sounds.name: fuse_blow
sounds.trigger: Player bumps a fuse socket and blows the fuse

sounds.name: relay_hum
sounds.trigger: Relay boss idle hum. LOOPS: play it with looping on (the file loops by itself in Godot and has no click at the seam)

sounds.name: relay_overload
sounds.trigger: All three fuses blown: the relay boss alarms and crashes (then relay_down)

sounds.name: relay_down
sounds.trigger: Relay boss powers down and dies (after relay_overload)

sounds.name: amb_w1
sounds.trigger: World 1 ambience under the music: distant wind over dead wires, a faint signal blip. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: amb_w2
sounds.trigger: World 2 (relay yard) ambience under the music: transformer hum, far-off metal clanks, rain. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: lamp_on
sounds.trigger: A signal lamp sputters on

sounds.name: thunder
sounds.trigger: Lightning strikes: a crack, then a rolling rumble

sounds.name: menu_back
sounds.trigger: Menu back or cancel (pairs with menu_move and menu_confirm)

sounds.name: save_done
sounds.trigger: Game saved: a short two-note chime

sounds.name: voice_mast
sounds.trigger: Mast (old keeper) speaks: one blip every two letters

sounds.name: voice_tally
sounds.trigger: Tally (trader) speaks: one blip every two letters

sounds.name: voice_wren
sounds.trigger: Wren (kid with headphones) speaks: one blip every two letters

sounds.name: voice_brace
sounds.trigger: Brace (lineworker) speaks: one blip every two letters

sounds.name: voice_dot
sounds.trigger: Dot (switch operator, lamp head) speaks: one blip every two letters

sounds.name: voice_hum
sounds.trigger: Hum (relay technician) speaks: one blip every two letters

sounds.name: talk_open
sounds.trigger: A speech bubble opens

sounds.name: talk_next
sounds.trigger: Player advances to the next line of speech

sounds.name: door_open
sounds.trigger: A small house door opens (latch, then the creak)

sounds.name: door_close
sounds.trigger: A small house door shuts (the latch drops)

sounds.name: shop_buy
sounds.trigger: Player buys something in the shop

sounds.name: shop_deny
sounds.trigger: Player can't afford it (not enough shards)

sounds.name: amb_village
sounds.trigger: Last Relay village ambience under the music: soft wind, a distant wind chime, a far-off radio murmuring. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: village_theme
sounds.trigger: Last Relay village theme, on the Music bus. Calm D major, all four voices, 16 bars at 100 BPM. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: m_training
sounds.trigger: Training yard music, on the Music bus. Light and bouncy C major, 120 BPM, 16 bars; opens with the FIRST LIGHT figure. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: m_1_1
sounds.trigger: Level 1-1 FIRST LIGHT music, the game's main theme, on the Music bus. Hopeful and driving, G major, 150 BPM, 24 bars. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: m_1_1_bonus
sounds.trigger: Level 1-1 bonus room music, on the Music bus. Short, playful and sparkly, E major, 180 BPM, 16 bars; bars 5 and 6 quote FIRST LIGHT. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: m_1_2
sounds.trigger: Level 1-2 LOOSE GROUND music, on the Music bus. Nervous and off-balance, E minor, 144 BPM, 24 bars; opens with the FIRST LIGHT figure a half-beat late. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: m_1_3
sounds.trigger: Level 1-3 THE PRESSES music, on the Music bus. Mechanical and syncopated over a steady thud, C minor, 112.5 BPM, 20 bars; bars 5 and 17 quote FIRST LIGHT. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: m_1_4
sounds.trigger: Level 1-4 THE GATE music, the World 1 finale, on the Music bus. Tense then heroic, D minor, 163.6 BPM, 24 bars; bars 17 and 18 turn FIRST LIGHT into a major-key call. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: m_2_1
sounds.trigger: Level 2-1 RAIL HOPPERS music, on the Music bus. Bouncy A minor with rain and lightning, 133.3 BPM, 20 bars; opens with the Switchyard motif. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: m_2_2
sounds.trigger: Level 2-2 SPIKED LINE music, on the Music bus. Cautious, low and creeping, B minor, 90 BPM, 16 bars, with rain; the bass creeps through the Switchyard motif. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: m_2_3
sounds.trigger: Level 2-3 CHANNELS music, on the Music bus. The two pulse voices call and answer and swap roles when the world flips, G minor, 124.1 BPM, 20 bars, with static; built on the Switchyard motif. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)

sounds.name: m_2_4
sounds.trigger: Level 2-4 THE RELAY music, the World 2 boss, on the Music bus. Fast, relentless and urgent, F minor, 200 BPM, 32 bars, lightning every eight bars; built on the Switchyard motif. LOOPS (the file loops by itself in Godot, no click at the seam)
